mentions.name: Ontario open data MCP
mentions.description: This MCP server exposes Ontario open data to LLMs. It uses DuckDB as a common local database to cache and run queries against CSVs and other data formats, enabling insights that go across datasets.
mentions.problem: A wealth of Ontario open data is locked behind CSVs and other data formats, making it hard to query and combine.
